message: The other day, I realized we hadn’t updated our go-bags in a while, so I gathered the kids for a little ‘emergency prep party.’ We pulled out blankets, made some hot cocoa, and turned it into a cozy afternoon of packing essentials and sharing stories about our favorite adventures. 🥰 It felt less like a chore and more like a fun family bonding experience! What’s your favorite way to make preparedness a little more enjoyable?
